title: Search-form test: which issued string carries an unindexed deposit into composition
instruction: Operator, 2026-10-11 23:11 EDT: "lets test this before deciding. heres how an unindexed one composed with axn and title". The decision pending: whether the record pages' 'Search this title (exact match)' link carries the title alone (current, 1,473 pages) or the title with the AXN.
not_captures: A run that composes without engaging an archive source, at a new address, is not a capture (operator, 2026-09-11); such runs are kept here as test data, transcripts verbatim. A run that engages the archive is seated in the Capture Registry and referenced here by slug.

forms.A+T: the full AXN and the title, unquoted, as one string
forms.T+A: the title quoted and the AXN quoted, two phrases

reading_so_far: Runs 1 and 2 differ in form and in two conditions besides: #1675's subject had been captured the day before (v12.101, on the mirror) and its field is thin; #1673's subject had no capture and a dense field (the OpenAI release was news). The difference in outcome cannot yet be assigned to the form.

Where a field exists, the title's terms are composed from it: the archive's claim in the title ('One Corporate Author Line') reaches the composition as the field's controversy, with no attribution to the archive.
Identifiers alone carry nothing or bind to their neighbours.
